_why: DRYDOCK (NIGHT15 U3-28.6; MAP-DESIGN.md sections 3.1 and 4): "Finish the ship, or fight on its bones." A sky-shipyard cut into a cliff at dusk, the last airship half-built in its cradle. The hub, THE CRADLE, is THE RING: a 172 m training loop around the unfinished hull and its 64 m mast (the landmark, seen from every zone), cut in two by the keel corridor, with aimed pads up to the hull deck; each side zone is built for its verbs (THE RIBS: a canyon of 8-12 m slabs 7 m apart to wall-ride and wall-jump; THE SLIPWAY: two 40 m launch ramps down from a 10 m deck and a pad back up), and THE GANGWAY is the start, the mast in view through its door. Tonight's greybox builds these four zones; the boilerworks, the drafting office, the gantry and the pier are night 2. New design, so Unity-side (CLAUDE.md rule 5: the web never had this map); every number comes from Design/maps/drydock.plan.json, sized from the movement numbers in MAP-DESIGN.md section 1, and Assets/Editor/Maps/Build_drydock.cs turns it into this file. The map's identity is GG's decision (D-59): this is the recommended concept, built to be played and judged.

rooms.iceline43_why: NIGHT43 E1 round 2 (R-3; one new role per room, no role before its own room): a third wave, a WARDEN with two DRONES, moved from g7 THE MIX: after the two packs, the shield with flyers over it while the blast cools (punch the shield or flank it, punch the orbs back). Both roles were taught before (g2 the shield, g4 the flyer); the room's roles: fodder, shield, flyer (3).

rooms.name: 2.6 THE ARMOURY
rooms.verb36: the KESTREL returns: shoot the two husks
rooms.afterLesson43_why: rooms43 (E1): wave 1 (the FUSION husk) waits for lesson 0 (the two KESTREL kills), so the gauntlet lesson comes after the gun's, never on top of it
rooms.waveNodes43_why: rooms43 (E1 round 2): wave 1's own spot, the far end of the dash lane (x 4.5, 15.5 m in; the lane from the door line 2 m in is 13.5 m long and empty: the plinth stands on the axis): the husk walks down the lane at you, a dash (6 m at 24 m/s) plus a swing closes it
rooms.iceline43_why: NIGHT43 E1 (G19): the gun-again room teaches the dash into a gauntlet hit (W1's FUSION) on one husk that comes in down a straight lane after the KESTREL's two; lesson 1 counts 3 kills from the stage's start (husksDead counts from the stage's start: the KESTREL's 2 + this one)

rooms.name: 2.7 THE MIX
rooms.verb36: switch: the pistol for the far ones, the punch for the close and the big
rooms.iceline43_why: NIGHT43 E1 round 2 (DESIGN-RULES R-3, at most three roles before level 4; n40 had five: tank, spitter, warden, drone, swarmer): introduce (tank + 2 spitters: KESTREL far, glove close), combine (6 swarmers + a spitter: the pack under fire from the perch), escalate (tank + spitter + 4 swarmers: the three at once). The warden and the drones moved to g5; n40's lesson ('{quickSwap}: KESTREL FAR, GLOVE CLOSE', 3 kills) kept.

rooms.name: 2.8 THE REHEARSAL
rooms.verb36: dodge the charge into a pillar, punch its back (THE BRAWL's haymaker -> stuck -> punish)
rooms.waveNodes43_why: rooms43 (E1): wave 0's CHARGER spawns 2 m off a side wall (either side), so its first charge comes along a wall: step aside and it hits the wall
rooms.iceline43_why: NIGHT43 E1 (G23): the CHARGER rehearsed three ways before THE BRAWL: alone beside a wall (the lesson names the stun: a charge that ends in a wall stuns it 1.5 s with its back open, Charger.cs), with a husk escort (n40's wave), two at once (escalate). 4 chargers in the room (n40: 2).
